description: State Representative Jason Buchsbaum (R-69) has been unanimously endorsed by the Republican nominating convention to run for reelection as State Representative for Connecticut’s 69th House District. Delegates from Bridgewater, New Milford, Roxbury and Southbury recently met at the Southbury Senior Center to vote on the endorsement. The nominating convention was chaired by Region 15 Board of Education Secretary Tom Marks, and Southbury Board of Finance member Steve Giacomi served as Secretary. In
